sql.value: select kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.model_id, kb.embedding_model_id, kb.chunk_size, kb.chunk_overlap, kb.chunk_strategy, kb.retrieval_strategy, kb.top_k, kb.similarity_threshold, kb.enable_status, kb.create_by, kb.create_time, kb.update_by, kb.update_time, kb.is_deleted, kb.revision, m.model_name as model_name, em.model_name as embedding_model_name, (select count(*) from ai_kb_document kd where kd.kb_id = kb.id) as document_count from ai_knowledge_base kb left join ai_model m on m.id = kb.model_id left join ai_embedding_model em on em.id = kb.embedding_model_id where kb.is_deleted=0 #[and kb.name like :name] #[and kb.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by kb.create_time desc
